en: A vintage, colorized postcard showing a street scene with trees and an old observatory building featuring a red dome. There are several people visible near a cart under the trees, and the architecture suggests a Central European city. The text at the top identifies the location as Zagreb and mentions 'Kipni trg — Popov toranj.' The overall atmosphere and style indicate an early 20th-century setting.
